label: TARGET REPAIR ONLY - no new representation, no tonal candidate, no visual grammar, no CQT, no CRP, no NNLS, no learned audio estimator
question: When the symbolic harmonic oracle is made causal and timbre-aware with respect to acoustic ATTACK timing, how much of the remaining cross-family failure disappears?

construct_boundary.this_is_NOT_an_acoustic_transcription_or: the MIDI note identities are already known. The ONLY thing corrected is WHEN an already-known MIDI note becomes acoustically active.
construct_boundary.velocity: still excluded, exactly as J3D decided, so a crescendo cannot become harmonic movement
construct_boundary.attack_only: J3I found the release side essentially sound - audible MIDI-gate coverage about 1.0 across families, release_10 within one hop - and the mismatch concentrated in ATTACK. Only attack is corrected. No release model is created.

permitted_inputs: cross-fitted attack-envelope statistics learned from isolated rendered audio
TARGET_MUST_BE_REPRESENTATION_INDEPENDEN.enforcement: the kernel builder imports no module from edgeai.mir.tonal_projection or edgeai.mir.host_chroma, and this is asserted in the result receipt.

J3J_A_CROSS_FITTED_ATTACK_KERNEL.episode_source: the isolated-note episodes already generated by J3I, unchanged

reused_without_change.timing_envelope: RMS over a 512-sample (32 ms) rectangular window on the analysis hop grid, causal
reused_without_change.absolute_silence_criterion: silence_mask at SILENCE_FLOOR_DBFS = -60.0 dBFS on the existing dsp_register_features RMS

full_attack_curve_not_a_scalar.definition: a(tau) = envelope(note_on + tau) / local_peak, clipped to [0, 1], tau in hops
full_attack_curve_not_a_scalar.local_peak: maximum of the timing envelope inside [note_on, note_off + 0.2 s] - the J3I definition, unchanged

TRUNCATION_RULE_DECLARED_BEFORE_AGGREGAT.rule: a(tau) is taken for tau = 0..K_MAX. It is made monotone non-decreasing by a running maximum (cumulative max), so that vibrato or tremolo dips during the rise are not modelled as de-activation. The episode also contributes only up to its own note-off, and episodes shorter than K_MAX hold their last observed value.
TRUNCATION_RULE_DECLARED_BEFORE_AGGREGAT.why_K_MAX_32: 1.024 s, four times the lag-8 movement window and four times the slowest measured attack_50 (synth_lead_pad, 8 hops). Declared, not tuned.

full_attack_curve_not_a_scalar.kernel_from_episodes: k_raw(tau) = MEDIAN over contributing episodes of the monotone a(tau). k(tau) = k_raw(tau) / k_raw(K_MAX), so the kernel reaches exactly 1.0 at K_MAX and the SHAPE of the rise is preserved. k(tau) = 1.0 for tau > K_MAX. This implements the brief's 'after the kernel reaches 1.0, hold at 1.0'.

CROSS_FITTING_MANDATORY.scheme: grouped leave-one-track-out. When evaluating any stem of track T, that stem's family kernel is built ONLY from episodes belonging to tracks other than T. The evaluated track never contributes waveform information to its own target.
CROSS_FITTING_MANDATORY.reported: the number of source episodes and source tracks contributing to every held-out family kernel

FALLBACK_HIERARCHY_DECLARED_BEFORE_ANY_C.why_20: the same low-power flag already used in J3I. Not a new threshold.

attack_class_groups_defined_A_PRIORI_BY_.why_a_priori: grouping by measured attack time would let all-track measurements leak into a held-out track's group assignment. Organological grouping uses no measurement at all.
attack_class_groups_defined_A_PRIORI_BY_.disclosure: J3I measured brass and strings at 1-hop attack_50, so placing them in BLOWN_BOWED is an a-priori choice that its own measurement does not support. Both families are small (17 and 12 episodes) and neither is among the seven the brief asks to report. Recorded so the choice is visible.

J3J_B_ACOUSTIC_ACTIVATION_PC.construction: note_activation(t) = MIDI_gate(t) x k_family(t - note_on). After the kernel reaches 1.0 it holds at 1.0 until MIDI note-off, then drops to 0 using the EXISTING rectangular gate. No release model.
J3J_B_ACOUSTIC_ACTIVATION_PC.polyphony: the kernel is applied independently to each MIDI note before pitch-class mass is summed
J3J_B_ACOUSTIC_ACTIVATION_PC.window_integration: the existing state integrates each note's duration overlap across the 2048-sample analysis window, which spans 4 hops. The activation weight for frame i is therefore the mean of k over the 4 hops that window covers - k box-filtered to 4 taps - so that activation is smeared exactly as the overlap already is. Declared here.
after_weighting: M_tv computed at the same lag 8
J3J_B_ACOUSTIC_ACTIVATION_PC.IDENTICAL_FRAME_SET_FOR_BOTH_TARGETS: the evaluated frames are fixed by the OLD target's symbolic pair validity intersected with J3I's AUDIO_SUPPORTED_PAIR mask, and the SAME frame set is used for both targets. Otherwise a difference could come from a changed denominator rather than from the target. Declared before any score.
J3J_B_ACOUSTIC_ACTIVATION_PC.REPORTED_DIAGNOSTIC_not_a_gate: the change in explicitly-silent frame count under the new target is reported, since a kernel starting near zero could in principle manufacture silence.

J3J_C_TARGET_EFFECT_MEASURED_BEFORE_ANY_.run_order: the target's own change is quantified BEFORE any representation is scored against it
per_family_reported: movement correlation old vs new (Pearson and Spearman between M_tv_old and M_tv_new)
fraction of top-5% movement events whose timing changes
number of events added and removed

reported_per_family_against_BOTH_targets: event recall with the existing +/- 2-hop tolerance
J3J_D_RERUN_EXISTING_REPRESENTATIONS_ONL.the_important_comparison: not absolute R-squared, but how much changing ONLY the oracle changes each family's apparent failure

per_family.event_miss_reduction: old missed-event rate minus new missed-event rate, where missed = 1 - event-tolerant recall
per_family.false_movement_reduction: old false-movement rate minus new false-movement rate

J3J_E_TARGET_ATTRIBUTABLE_FRACTION.fraction_of_the_old_gap_attributable_to_: reported per family as (old_miss - new_miss) / old_miss when old_miss >= 0.10, and null otherwise, so a tiny denominator cannot produce a large fraction

SPECIAL_ATTENTION_SYNTH_PAD.why_decisive: J3I measured attack_50 = 8 hops, exactly the lag-8 harmonic-movement comparison interval
questions: does event-tolerant P0 recall materially exceed the old 0.5139?
does its false-movement rate fall materially below the old 0.0312?
does C3 behave differently from P0?
SPECIAL_ATTENTION_SYNTH_PAD.material: the established 0.10 absolute scale, applied to these bounded fractions. No new threshold.

readings.recall_up_and_false_down: the old target owned much more of the apparent synth failure than J3I could establish
readings.recall_up_false_still_high: target timing explained the misses; the representation still creates spurious tonal movement
readings.neither_changes: the representation owns most of the synth failure

SPECIAL_ATTENTION_CHROMATIC_PERCUSSION.expectation: J3I found essentially no attack or gate mismatch (attack_50 = 1 hop, release_10 = 0, coverage 1.0), so target repair should change little
SPECIAL_ATTENTION_CHROMATIC_PERCUSSION.RED_FLAG_RULE: if chromatic percussion improves dramatically under J3J, that is a red flag and the target construction is inspected. It is NOT celebrated. Its known failure mechanism remains inharmonic partial structure against a harmonic pitch-class representation.

LANGUAGE_CORRECTION_CARRIED_FORWARD.retired: a slow attack cannot manufacture movement while symbolic state is stable
LANGUAGE_CORRECTION_CARRIED_FORWARD.correct: a slow or spectrally evolving attack CAN make an AUDIO pitch-class estimator move while a rectangular symbolic pitch-class target stays constant. For this programme that movement may still count as unwanted TIMBRE contamination of the harmonic descriptor, but the physical mechanism is real. J3J determines how much of it disappears when the oracle models activation timing.

outcomes_exactly_as_briefed_no_additions.TARGET_CORRECTION_DOMINANT: acoustic-activation correction materially rehabilitates the previously weak families AND leaves little residual disparity on event recall and false movement. Reading: the old rectangular oracle created most of the apparent timbre boundary. Do not reopen representation work.
outcomes_exactly_as_briefed_no_additions.TARGET_CORRECTION_PARTIAL_REPRESENTATION: some families materially improve but synth_lead_pad, chromatic_percussion or others retain substantial event misses or false movement. Reading: J3I's MIXED conclusion survives under an explicitly repaired target, and representation work is justified for the residual families only.
outcomes_exactly_as_briefed_no_additions.TARGET_CORRECTION_IMMATERIAL: changing to the acoustically activated target does not materially change the weak-family result. Reading: representation / front-end owns almost all of the remaining failure.

NO_NEW_BLOCKING_GATES.declared_construction_constants_are_not_: K_MAX = 32 hops, the 20-episode fallback minimum, the organological groups and the 4-tap window mean are TARGET CONSTRUCTION, fixed before any candidate is scored, and appear nowhere in an outcome test.

if_partial_returns.action: STOP. Return a ranked maximum-three representation hypotheses for the RESIDUAL problem only. Do NOT execute them.
ranking_must_answer_per_hypothesis: whether it requires a new frontend
expected benefit for synth/pad versus inharmonic percussion SEPARATELY

J3H_remains_separate: J3H asks whether Moises/LALAL separation changes real-audio source-conditioned harmonic observability on commercial recordings. J3J uses exact BabySlakh rendered stems to fix target semantics. Different questions; not merged.
what_this_is_not: not a new representation, not a tonal candidate, not a visual experiment
not promotable - the BabySlakh tracks remain consumed
not a reopening of the -1 hop timing question
